description: This file defines the NmapProcessor class which implements the IProcessor interface to process Nmap scan XML files; it parses hosts, addresses, and open ports, and generates asset objects for each host and port.

classes.name: NmapProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes Nmap XML scan results, extracting host and port information to create assets.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a CommandProcessorJob by reading its associated Nmap XML file, extracting host and port data, and returning the result.
